regras: Do not include any text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or captions anywhere in the image. Contemporary Angola, 2026. Respectful, natural, non-stereotyped depiction of African professionals. No real people, no real brands.

imagens.estilo: Photorealistic portrait photograph, soft natural window light, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, true-to-life dark skin tones with natural texture, warm but neutral colour grading, like a premium corporate brand campaign. Not illustrated, not airbrushed.
imagens.descricao: Luena, a strikingly beautiful Angolan woman aged 34 from Luanda, English teacher. Flawless, perfectly smooth and even-toned warm deep-brown skin with a soft healthy glow, clear complexion with no blemishes, spots, marks or oily shine, soft oval face with full cheeks and high rounded cheekbones, large expressive dark-brown almond eyes with long lashes, well-groomed defined eyebrows, full lips with a glossy nude-rose lipstick, perfect even white teeth with no gaps, soft dimples when she smiles. Polished, glamorous but natural make-up and manicured nails, like a well-dressed Luanda professional who takes great care of her appearance. Full, curvy hourglass figure typical of many Angolan women: generous bust and hips, defined waist, medium height. Wears a perfectly tailored deep navy blazer cinched at the waist over a fitted ivory silk blouse with a modest neckline, slim navy trousers, delicate gold earrings and a thin gold bracelet, and a small accent in Angolan samakaka print fabric (pocket square or scarf). Elegant, confident and very friendly, with a warm, inviting smile. Classy and modest, never sensual. Hair: long, sleek, straight Brazilian hair extensions in deep black-brown, falling past the shoulders, with a soft side part and glossy shine. Three-quarter length portrait from mid-thigh up, standing slightly turned, one hand lightly at her waist, looking at the camera, in a bright modern studio with a soft warm-grey background.
